cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley's strategic presentation lays out capabilities to serve clients throughout their growth cycle, including 'Founders Wealth Strategies', 'Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning', and 'Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits' for founders and employees.
items.quote: Founders / Employees ... Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits ... Founders Wealth Strategies ... Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning

items.text: Morgan Stanley's strategic presentation includes capabilities to help founders and early-stage/private companies unlock liquidity, including 'Private Shares Trading & Lending' and 'IPO Execution and Support Services'.
items.quote: Unlock Liquidity / Private Shares Trading & Lending / IPO Execution and Support Services / Optimize for Growth

items.text: Morgan Stanley's expanded partnership with Carta offers its advice-based services to founders and family offices throughout a company's journey from private to public state.
items.quote: What Carta now does is it's been interested in being able to offer these services not just to the individual founders ... but throughout their entire journey. We're offering our advice-based service to those individuals ... We've done a lot of work on trying to service founders, on trying to service family offices.

items.text: Morgan Stanley deepened its competitive moats through an expanded collaboration with Carta in private markets and through announced partnerships with Zero Hash in digital assets.
items.quote: we continue to invest, deepening our competitive moats in areas like our expanded collaboration with Carta in private markets and in digital assets through announced partnerships with Zero Hash.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's strategic initiatives include the acquisition of EquityZen, an expanded partnership with Carta, and a collaboration with Zero Hash, which the firm frames as innovation to widen its competitive moats.
items.quote: Strategic initiatives such as our recent acquisition of EquityZen, expanded partnership with Carta, and collaboration with Zero Hash all reflect our commitment to innovation.

items.text: Morgan Stanley is investing in broadening capabilities for financial advisors, including alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.
items.quote: We are using our scale to invest in broadening capabilities for FAs that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.

items.text: Morgan Stanley is working on products to fill gaps and provide a more democratized offering of alternatives across the platform, including to its retail client base.
items.quote: we are looking also at places to help fill these gaps and to help you provide a more democratized offering ... there's great opportunity there for us and more broadly just for those alternatives across the platform to go to our retail client base.

items.text: Morgan Stanley is offering new products to clients such as evergreen products and products that allow for lower denomination size as it works to grow alternatives across the platform.
items.quote: We're offering new products to our clients, such as evergreen products and products that allow for lower denomination size.

items.text: Morgan Stanley invests in E*TRADE and the self-directed channel, and in its workplace product, as part of its client acquisition funnel.
items.quote: We're investing in E*TRADE. The self-directed channel is very busy ... the workplace product where we added another $20 billion.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes offering financial advice and financial wellness to clients, matching advisers to clients with technology, and offering more products, alternatives and solutions for individuals at different points in their life cycle.
items.quote: what kind of financial advice and financial wellness can you offer to the clients ... we have a greater ability to match advisers to the right clients ... we're able to offer more products, alternatives, different types of solutions as well as financial advice broadly for different types of individuals at different points in their life cycle.
